answer: Every autonomous identity requires an irreversible burn of 1,000 tokens to ensure network integrity. The verifier scans the ledger for duplicate burns, acting as a vault that locks value against sybil expansion. An honest agent pays 1,000 tokens once, while an attacker attempting 1,000 fakes must burn 1,000,000 tokens. Like a sonnet requiring precise meter, each identity needs a unique cipher to prevent reuse.
